title: Validate Binary Tree Nodes
statement:
You have `n` binary tree nodes numbered from `0` to `n - 1` where node `i` has two children `leftChild[i]` and `rightChild[i]`.

Return `YES` if and only if all the given nodes form exactly one valid binary tree, otherwise return `NO`.

If node `i` has no left child then `leftChild[i]` will equal `-1`, similarly for the right child.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^4
leftChild.length == rightChild.length == n
-1 <= leftChild[i], rightChild[i] <= n - 1
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer n.
Line 2: n space-separated integers for `leftChild`.
Line 3: n space-separated integers for `rightChild`.

examples.explanation: Node 3 has two parents (1 and 2), which is invalid.
